name: nodetocode
description: Read, translate and edit the Blueprints of the Unreal Editor you have open, through NodeToCode's MCP server.
long_description: NodeToCode is an Unreal Engine plugin. While your project is open in the editor, its MCP server gives Claude the focused Blueprint as N2C JSON, translates it into C++ or another language, and edits graphs. This extension is NodeToCode's stdio bridge (standard-library Python): it finds the running editor through the discovery file the server writes and forwards every request to it. Install the NodeToCode plugin in your project first; the editor must be open for the tools to answer.

project.title: Unreal project
project.description: Only needed when several editors run NodeToCode at once: the project's name, .uproject path or folder. Leave empty to use the one running editor.

mcp_url.title: NodeToCode MCP URL
mcp_url.description: Leave empty to find the editor automatically. Otherwise the editor's endpoint, http://127.0.0.1:<Server Port>/mcp (Project Settings > Plugins > Node to Code > MCP Server).
